scope.method: Independent reading of saved manufacturer HTML, Shopify JSON, catalog/package-label evidence and product images; targeted official-source alternatives for conflicts. No structural validator or browser runtime used.

criticalHolds.scope: 25 lb filler packages currently represented as 330 yd; Clear, Lo-Vis Green and Neon Lime
criticalHolds.releaseCondition: Remove the ambiguous filler packages and their 330 yd option at 25 lb pending exact-SKU clarification. Keep the verified diameter and separate 1200 yd SKUs 604-1025/604-1025G/604-1025L. Qualify copy that currently offers 330/1200 yd without the 25 lb exception.

criticalHolds.scope: 40 and 50 lb; Natural Clear and Disappearing Pink; 30 and 100 yd
criticalHolds.releaseCondition: Withhold both strength rows and update the source/FAQ claim, or supply exact-model manufacturer clarification establishing an authoritative unit. Other verified strengths are not blocked by this finding. Retain the existing separate 130 lb hold.

findings.title: 25 lb filler SKUs have unresolved 250 versus 330 yard lengths

evidence.method: Independent live ordinary HTTP fetch; status 200; parsed embedded JSON without using the main browser or writing Group B files
evidence.result: All three exact filler SKUs repeat the 250/330 conflict. The separate 604-1025, 604-1025G and 604-1025L length fields and image labels all agree on 1200 yd.

findings.impact: The retained purchase option presents an unresolved length as verified. If the 250 yd image label is correct, a 330 yd recommendation overstates supply by 80 yd (32%). This is the same kind of exact-SKU package conflict already excluded for Elite's heavy fillers.
findings.requiredAction: Withhold only the three 25 lb filler packages and their 330 yd option until manufacturer clarification; do not substitute 250 yd solely from conflicting metadata. Keep the 25 lb diameter and verified 1200 yd bulk packages. Add the exception to package guidance and source notes.

findings.title: Two retained leader diameters exceed the source's printed rounding intervals
findings.calculation: The sources print 0.001 mm and 0.001 in increments: 0.0005 mm + (0.0005 in * 25.4 mm/in) = 0.0132 mm. Removing trailing zeros after numeric parsing does not establish lower source precision.

evidence.locator: 30 yd table rows TK LD 40LB NCL and TK LD 50LB NCL; same pairs repeated in 100 yd table
30 yd table rows TK LD 40LB DP and TK LD 50LB DP; same pairs repeated in 100 yd table
Official alternative, TOPKNOT LEADER 30YDS: R1232-/40 lb and R1233-/50 lb repeat the same three-decimal pairs

findings.impact: The pack describes retained pairs as within rounding tolerance while correctly holding 130 lb under that same rule. These two additional pairs are not within it. This is a source conflict, not proof that either individual diameter is the correct physical measurement.
findings.requiredAction: Hold the two strength rows or obtain exact-model clarification; do not silently convert one unit or infer a looser tolerance from parsed numbers. Update the source note and omission FAQ to include these holds.

imageReview.method: Visually inspected all 22 final-asset contact-sheet entries; read the contact-sheet producer to confirm it used product.localImagePath. Re-encoded each saved manufacturer source in memory using the recorded image settings and obtained byte-identical output to all 22 final WebPs. Resolved image URLs against raw primary page data, including parsed Shopify image arrays rather than escaped-string matching.
imageReview.advisory: Hybrid, TopKnot MainLine, TopKnot Leader and original SuperBraid use genuine 600x300 manufacturer canvases with large white margins. Product bounds are approximately 224-236 by 285-295 pixels. Their identities are legible, but fine print should not be treated as a high-resolution inspection image. Not a source-identity hold; presentation remains main's responsibility.
